headline: ABF, Memory, MLCC Raise Alarms! Six Major AI Components Reviewed: Which Will Lead the Charge? | Finance
summary: Following a July sell-off linked to South Korean leveraged products, the article reports losses of 43.94% in the Korean market, over 28% in the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, 18.3% in Taiwan and 17% in Japan's Nikkei.
why: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tracks major US-listed chip companies, and AI supply-chain components such as substrates and memory are central to the sector's earnings outlook.
